rows.ARS:
Deep pink Hybrid Tea.
Exhibition name: Cherry Lady ®
rows.Origin:
Bred by Tim Hermann Kordes (Germany, 2002).
Introduced in United States by Newflora™ LLC as 'Cherry Lady'.
Introduced in Germany by W. Kordes' Söhne (Retail) in 2012 as 'Cherry Lady'.
Introduced in United States by Edmunds' Roses in before 2013 as 'Fiji'.
rows.Bloom: Deep pink. Cherry-pink. Mild fragrance. 55 to 65 petals. Average diameter 4". Large, very full (41+ petals), in small clusters, globular bloom form. Blooms in flushes throughout the season. Leafy sepals, long, pointed, ovoid buds.
rows.Habit:
Arching, bushy, dense, upright. Semi-glossy, medium green foliage. 5 leaflets.

Height: up to 47" (up to 120cm). Width: up to 32" (up to 80cm).
rows.Growing: Disease susceptibility: very blackspot resistant., very mildew resistant.
rows.Patents:
United States - Patent No: PP 26,171 on 1 Dec 2015 VIEW USPTO PATENT
Application No: 13/987,680 on 20 Aug 2013
The new variety of rose plant of the present invention originated from a controlled crossing in a breeding program of two distinct parents during the summer of 2002. The crossing was between an un-named seedling, the seed parent, and another un-named seedling, the pollen parent by the same inventor.
